description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class named AbstractVueController within the OrangeHRM framework. It manages Vue.js components rendering, template handling, and HTTP responses, serving as a base class for Vue-based controllers in the HRM system.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract base controller for handling Vue.js component rendering within the OrangeHRM system. It manages Twig templating, component setup, and HTTP responses, providing lifecycle methods for pre- and post-rendering processes.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Retrieves the current Twig Environment instance.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Specifies the template file to be used for rendering.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the current template file name.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue component to be rendered; throws exception if already handled.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization hook for subclasses to override.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook before rendering; meant to be overridden for pre-render setup.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component within the specified template using Twig.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook after rendering; meant to be overridden for post-render actions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main handler to process the request, manage rendering, and generate the HTTP response.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag used for storing rendering context variables.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles bad request scenarios by setting a default component.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object and marks the request as handled.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks whether the request has been handled.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Marks whether the request has been handled.
